title: Adaptive numeric arrow increments
changes: Arrow key increments are adaptive to the current value and use human-friendly 1/2/5 decades
Native number-input spinner step changes as the value changes without affecting free typing
Range slider arrows and chart keyboard arrows use the same adaptive increments without altering pointer drag behavior
Savings breakdown target arrows also follow adaptive steps while preserving allocation limits and budget linkage
Integer duration fields retain integer values and numeric input limits remain enforced
